invariants: Baseline and fastpath have byte-identical monitored filesystem outputs, including receipt
Only mode draft-to-ready may change in settings; notes and remaining settings stay unchanged
Linux inotify independently counts atomic replacements of settings.json
Invalid scope or precondition causes no new file or settings write
A repeated or recovered request must not duplicate the settings write
Verification checks actual final bytes and never trusts a previous success message
Same approved request and real upstream terminal policy in both paths
Model response counts include the final response; no live-provider speed claim
durability_limit: Prepared receipt, file and directory fsync are implemented; only injected process termination is tested, not OS crash or power loss. Single-host advisory lock; no distributed exactly-once guarantee.
